text:
IncidentBot: :warning: STAGE ROLLOUT ALERT for service=model-serving (release-2026.03.15-13) - canary error spike detected

Maya: got the alert. anyone oncall? saw errors and latency up from 13:23 UTC. dash link: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/model-serving (panels loading weird)

Liam: I'm up. quick glance shows canary hosts with 12-18% 5xx and p95/p99 traces increasing. config note: new quantization kernel enabled for canary.

Maya: we only have p50/p90 on the overview, no p99. alert is firing on p90 which masked tail. that's bad.

Sam (support): customer impact: batch of timeouts - 22 tickets in queue, 3 high-priority customers reporting retries.

Julia (product): please assess scope. do we need a customer comms?

Liam: SLO check -> last 30m availability 99.62% vs 99.9% target. burn happening but not exploded yet. recommend immediate feature-flag kill + rollback.

Maya: trying feature-flag dashboard but it's timing out for me.

Liam: flipping flag via CLI now:
```
POST /api/flags/model-serving-v2/state
{ "state": "off", "actor": "oncall/liam" }
```

DeployBot: ff model-serving-v2 set OFF by Liam at 13:31:40 UTC. Traffic shifting.

Maya: initiating rollback of canary to previous stable image.

Liam: rollback command issued - estimated 60s to converge.

DeployBot: rollback finished at 13:33:20 UTC. Healthcheck rates back to normal on most hosts.

Sam (support): ticket surge slowing; outreach sent to affected paying customers. no data loss, just increased latencies/timeouts.

Maya: root cause candidate: quantized kernel has worse tail for long-context sequences. observability gaps: missing p99 panel, synthetic checks don't exercise heavy sequences, flag dashboard flaky. delayed detection + delayed kill.

Liam: follow-ups I'm taking: add p99 to model-serving overview; create synthetic check that runs long-context inference; add p99-based alert threshold and short-window circuit-breaker; document CLI fallbacks for flag kills.

Maya: handoff - I'm off at 14:00 UTC. Liam owns postmortem and fixes. I'll review.

Julia (product): scheduling postmortem review tomorrow 09:00 UTC (product + sres + support). bring timeline + metric diffs + customer list.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0315-07 created. Severity S2. PD notified.

Liam: created tickets: INC-2026-0315-07-1 (add p99 panel), -2 (synth long-seq), -3 (flag-dashboard reliability). ETA 48h. temporary mitigation: disable quantized kernel in staged rollouts until p99 telemetry validated.

Maya: recommend runbook update: require p99 visibility and long-seq synthetic pass before >10% traffic for kernel changes.

Sam (support): continuing customer follow-ups for next 3 hours. will update incident ticket when all customers acknowledged.

Liam: will draft postmortem and share by EOD tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:
